entities.summary: Shunji Dodo (b. 1947, Osaka Prefecture) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Osaka Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
